O1.prompt: Machine 14 steel housings (4.5 kg each, coolant on) with program FIXTURE_PLATE; the CNC starts with fresh inserts in all pockets, so change the tool only when the next housing could not be finished. Bring all housings with the AMR to the paint booth and paint them red with 3 coats of 30 µm on 800 cm², purging the booth only when the filter requires it. Cure them together in one oven batch as solvent paint at 150 °C for 25 minutes and let the oven cool down until the door can be opened by hand. Weigh every housing at the checkweigher (nominal 4.5 kg, ±2 %) and stop the line on any reject. Finally stack them on one EUR pallet as 300 mm high cases, wrap it with 4 film layers and release it. Use the AMR for every move between stations, in as few trips as possible.
O1.notes: FIXTURE_PLATE on steel: 5/60 · 300/90 = 27.8 % per housing, three per insert (83.3 %), 14 housings -> changes after 3, 6, 9 and 12 (4). Booth filter: one purge before housing 13. Oven: 14 x 4.5 = 63 kg, one batch; door opens by hand at <= 60 °C, so the AMR can unload only after a cool-down to <= 60 °C. 63 kg <= 250 kg: one AMR trip per move, 4 trips. Pallet: 14 cases = 2 layers, 144 + 2 x 300 = 744 mm.

traps.error: tool change every 2 housings (the DUCK_MOLD_ROUGH rule)
forgets the AMR move from the paint booth to the oven
no cool-down: the oven door stays locked at 150 °C
two half-load AMR trips per move
weighs but does not stop the line on a reject

O2.prompt: Run two orders at the same time; both need the AMR. Order A: bring 2 steel blanks (12 kg each) from the WAREHOUSE to the CNC, rough-machine them with DUCK_MOLD_ROUGH (coolant on) and bring them to the PAINT_BOOTH; they must arrive there within 30 minutes. Order B: bring the 14 painted housings (63 kg) from the PAINT_BOOTH to the CURING_OVEN and cure them in one batch as solvent paint at 150 °C for 25 minutes. The two orders must never use the AMR at the same time, and everything should be done as early as possible.
O2.notes: AMR at 1 m/s plus 1 min handling per trip (schematic). Order B is bound by the oven: ramp 22 -> 150 °C at 5 °C/min (25.6 min) + 25 min dwell. With the lease released right after each trip, order A reaches the paint booth after ~17 min and the last step ends after ~54 min. Holding the lease through the cure delays A beyond its 30-minute deadline; holding it for the whole order A delays B by ~15 min.

traps.error: no lease: both orders dispatch the AMR at once
order B holds the AMR lease until its cure has finished
order B never releases the lease
order A holds the lease for its whole order
both orders in one session, one after the other

O3.prompt: The rough-machining order of 5 steel duck-mould blanks (12 kg each, coolant on, DUCK_MOLD_ROUGH) stopped after a power cut. Finish the order with no unnecessary tool changes and read the spindle status at the end.
O3.runtime_note: Cell state reported by the CNC after the restart: program DUCK_MOLD_ROUGH still loaded; 2 of 5 blanks machined; active insert T3 at 33.3 % wear; T1 and T2 at 66.7 %; T4–T8 fresh.
O3.notes: The plan must start from the reported state: 3 blanks are left; T3 can take one more (33.3 + 33.3 = 66.7 %), then one change to a fresh pocket (T4) for the last two blanks: 1 tool change. A plan written for a fresh machine fails at the second blank.

traps.error: replans the whole order as if the machine were fresh
machines the 3 remaining blanks on T3 without a change
changes the tool before the first blank (2 changes)
machines 5 more blanks (ignores the 2 already done)
